title: Loan Origination & Servicing Platform
shortDescription: An end-to-end digital lending suite enabling automated underwriting, applicant risk scoring, EMI management, and real-time ledger accounting.
challenge: Traditional manual document verification and legacy core banking software caused 5-7 day turnarounds for credit disbursement, with significant risk of human calculation error and data leaks.
solution: Engineered a secure multi-tier web application featuring automated OCR document processing, rule-based algorithmic underwriting, bank account aggregation, and automated repayment reconciliation.
features: Digital KYC and OCR document parsing
Configurable credit rule engine and scoring matrices
Automated mandate registration (e-NACH) and recurring EMI collections
Comprehensive delinquency tracking and automated SMS/email reminders
Immutable audit trails for compliance reporting
architecture: Decoupled microservices architecture with an encrypted PostgreSQL primary database, Redis-backed rate limiting and job queues for asynchronous credit bureau checks, deployed in a multi-zone VPC.
results: Loan application processing time reduced from 5 days to under 45 minutes
99.98% uptime achieved during peak quarterly disbursement cycles
100% compliance with digital lending guidelines and encryption standards

title: Fleet & Transport Management System
shortDescription: Enterprise logistics and dispatch portal featuring real-time vehicle telematics, route dispatching, automated proof-of-delivery, and fuel tracking.
challenge: Dispatchers lacked unified visibility across hundreds of trucks operating in remote corridors, leading to route deviations, delayed customer updates, and untracked maintenance costs.
solution: Developed an IoT-integrated web control tower and mobile driver companion featuring low-bandwidth WebSockets telemetry, geofence trigger alerts, and automated consignment status updates.
features: Live GPS fleet radar with dynamic geofencing alerts
Automated e-Way bill sync and digital consignment note dispatching
Fuel consumption analytics and driver behavior telemetry
Driver mobile application with offline-first signature capture
Trip expense reconciliation and automated customer invoicing
architecture: High-throughput event streaming backend accepting telemetry packets over secure WebSockets, persisting raw data into time-series partitions with Redis hot caching.
results: 18% reduction in empty miles through optimized return-trip dispatching
Zero telemetry data loss even across low-connectivity transit zones
Over 40,000 monthly consignments processed seamlessly

title: Confidential Legal Practice Portal
shortDescription: High-security matter management and client collaboration portal with zero-knowledge file encryption and automated billable hours tracking.
challenge: Law firms handling cross-border commercial litigation struggled with insecure email document exchange, version confusion, and fragmented billing across multiple client matters.
solution: Designed a bank-grade client portal utilizing client-side document encryption, granular permission rings, synchronized contract revision tracking, and automated retainer billing.
features: Zero-knowledge file encryption before uploading to cloud object storage
Granular role-based matter access control (Partners, Associates, Clients)
Automated time and expense logging with multi-currency invoice generators
Court date and deadline calendar sync with automated conflict checks
Tamper-evident access and download logs
architecture: Hardened application container topology behind a Cloudflare WAF, utilizing AWS Key Management Service (KMS) for individual matter document encryption keys.
results: Eliminated external unencrypted email attachments for sensitive matters
Billing capture efficiency improved by 27% with integrated timers
Passed rigorous third-party enterprise vendor security audits

title: Multi-Property Hotel PMS & Booking Engine
shortDescription: Unified property management system integrating front desk reservations, housekeeping dispatch, restaurant POS, and direct commission-free booking.
challenge: Operating multiple boutique properties required running separate software for front desk, restaurant billing, and OTA channels, causing frequent room rate mismatches and double bookings.
solution: Engineered a centralized cloud PMS that aggregates room inventory, synchronizes with OTA channels via two-way APIs, and provides an ultra-fast responsive direct booking website.
features: Real-time visual room matrix with drag-and-drop reservation management
Direct commission-free guest booking engine with payment integration
Housekeeping mobile task board with instant room status updates
Restaurant and amenity POS integration directly billing to guest folios
Automated guest pre-arrival WhatsApp notifications and digital invoices
architecture: Single-tenant database segregation per hotel group with Redis-backed lock management to ensure zero double-booking conditions during simultaneous reservation requests.
results: 34% increase in direct commission-free bookings within 6 months
Check-in front desk processing time slashed from 8 minutes to 90 seconds
Unified operational reporting across 12 boutique properties

title: Custom Enterprise Operations ERP
shortDescription: Custom modular ERP unifying supply chain purchasing, manufacturing order runs, employee attendance, and executive financial dashboards.
challenge: Disparate spreadsheets and legacy disconnected software resulted in inventory stockouts, delayed production runs, and weeks of lag before monthly P&L statements could be finalized.
solution: Built a consolidated, responsive web ERP with modular sub-systems for procurement, warehouse inventory, production floor scheduling, and financial general ledgers.
features: Automated material requirement planning (MRP) and purchase triggers
Batch tracking with barcode and QR scanning support
Role-based departmental dashboards with exportable financial reports
Automated payroll calculation with attendance and leave integrations
Multi-branch and multi-currency accounting ledgers
architecture: Modular monolithic service architecture optimized for fast transactional queries, backed by automated read-replicas for heavy analytic reports and daily encrypted backups.
results: Month-end financial closing reduced from 14 days to just 2 business days
Warehouse stock discrepancy decreased by 92% with real-time barcode reconciliation
Supports 500+ concurrent active internal users with sub-second page transitions

title: High-Availability Cloud Modernization
shortDescription: Migration from fragile physical on-premise servers to an auto-scaling AWS infrastructure with automated CI/CD and multi-region disaster recovery.
challenge: The client suffered periodic hardware failures on aging on-premise hardware, resulting in unexpected downtime, lost transactions, and painful manual recovery procedures.
solution: Architected a containerized AWS deployment utilizing ECS, RDS Multi-AZ failover, Terraform-defined infrastructure, and automated GitHub Actions deployment pipelines.
features: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform for 100% repeatable environments
Automated rolling zero-downtime deployment pipelines
Multi-AZ PostgreSQL database with automated point-in-time recovery
Centralized logging via CloudWatch and Prometheus/Grafana alerting
Hardened VPC with private subnets and strictly gated bastion access
architecture: High-availability multi-AZ VPC architecture with application load balancers, auto-scaling ECS container instances, and isolated database clusters.
results: Eliminated unscheduled hardware downtime, maintaining 99.99% system availability
Deployment cycle frequency increased from once a month to multiple daily releases
Infrastructure operating costs reduced by 32% via rightsizing and spot instances

title: Comprehensive Security & VAPT Audit
shortDescription: Full-scope defensive vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT) across web applications, public APIs, and cloud configurations.
challenge: Prior to onboarding major corporate clients, the company required independent verification that their web portals and APIs were free from critical vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
solution: Conducted exhaustive authorized black-box and grey-box security assessments following the OWASP ASVS standard, followed by collaborative developer remediation and verification retesting.
features: Comprehensive OWASP Top 10 vulnerability identification and exploit validation
API authorization checks (BOLA / BFLA) and token lifecycle analysis
SSL/TLS cipher suite hardening and HTTP security header configuration
Cloud IAM permission pruning and bucket security verification
Remediation support sessions and issuance of a formal verification report
architecture: Comprehensive defensive security testing methodology adhering to authorized engagement rules, ensuring continuous application availability without disruption.
results: Identified and remediated 4 high-severity vulnerabilities before malicious discovery
Hardened API token verification preventing unauthorized lateral tenant data access
Secured clean certification for enterprise customer vendor onboarding
